items.title: How Aston Martin 'miracle' earned P12 and P14 for Bahrain GP
items.content: After a difficult season, Aston Martin finally got both cars into Q2 for the first time this year at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
items.contentSnippet: After a difficult season, Aston Martin finally got both cars into Q2 for the first time this year at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 阿斯顿·马丁在巴林大奖赛上首次在本赛季将两辆赛车送入Q2。尽管赛季表现不佳，但此次成绩是球队自年初以来的突破。
summaries.en: Aston Martin achieved a historic milestone at the Bahrain Grand Prix by qualifying both cars for Q2 for the first time this season, following a challenging period. This marked a significant improvement for the team.

items.title: Norris admits McLaren ‘a long way off the pace’ in Malaysia
items.content: Lando Norris qualified sixth for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia after struggling to keep up with McLaren’s rivals.
items.contentSnippet: Lando Norris qualified sixth for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia after struggling to keep up with McLaren’s rivals.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在巴林大奖赛马来西亚站比赛中夺冠，梅赛德斯车队获得前两名。勒克莱尔和维斯塔潘分列第三和第四。红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在排位赛中刷新了巴林国际赛道的最快单圈纪录。梅赛德斯车队的刘易斯·汉密尔顿在正赛中夺得冠军，乔治·拉塞尔获得亚军。红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯分列第三和第四。
summaries.en: Lando Norris qualified sixth for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, admitting McLaren is "a long way off the pace." He struggled to keep up with the competition during qualifying.

items.title: Antonelli rues error after feeling ‘front row was possible’
items.content: Kimi Antonelli will line up in P3 for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, but the Mercedes driver felt that he could have achieved a higher position had it not been for an earlier error.
items.contentSnippet: Kimi Antonelli will line up in P3 for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, but the Mercedes driver felt that he could have achieved a higher position had it not been for an earlier error.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 梅赛德斯车手安托内利将在巴林大奖赛中位列第三排发车，但他表示若非早前出现失误，本可争取到更靠前的位置。安托内利对失误表示懊恼，认为原本有机会获得前排发车资格。
summaries.en: Kimi Antonelli will start the Bahrain Grand Prix in the third position (P3) after qualifying, but he expressed regret for an earlier mistake that cost him a better spot. The Mercedes driver felt he could have achieved a front-row position if not for the error during the session.

items.content: Red Bull's Isack Hadjar was third quickest in Qualifying but will start P8 in the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia following a grid penalty.

summaries.en: Red Bull's Isack Hadjar qualified third for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia but will start in eighth place due to a grid penalty from the Sepang race. Despite the penalty, Hadjar is "enjoying" his injury comeback.
